sidebar.description: Product-minded engineer with 4+ years building data-rich platforms across fintech, cybersecurity, and e-commerce. I turn complex business problems into clean, scalable software.

experiences.engineai: I joined as a frontend engineer and within six months became the sole software engineer on all client projects, owning both frontend and backend for every enterprise delivery. After a company restructure, I moved into the Capital Markets squad where I now work directly with buy-side firms to build tailored solutions. Today I own every layer of each project, from architecting the full data pipeline to defining, training, and fine-tuning the AI models that power them.
experiences.wealthcome: I worked as the data engineer responsible for migrating millions of assets under management from third-party platforms into Wealthcome. That meant moving trillions of dollars worth of financial data, starting from scraping source platforms, loading into a staging database, and consolidating into production. Every step required strict validation workflows, robust data consolidation, and rigid transactional guarantees to make sure nothing was lost along the way.
experiences.brain: I developed a gamified cybersecurity awareness platform that helped enterprise clients reduce employee security incidents. I built interactive training modules and secure authentication systems, turning complex security concepts into engaging experiences that improved compliance rates and lowered organizational risk.
experiences.parkit: I built an automated domain marketplace with AI-powered showcase generation. I streamlined the full workflow from DNS configuration to AI-generated storefronts, and delivered admin dashboards with conversion analytics, helping domain sellers accelerate time-to-sale and grow portfolio revenue.
experiences.responsible: I developed circular fashion platforms that enabled brands to launch buy-back and resale programs with integrated cashback. I built brand-specific storefronts and inventory management dashboards, helping retailers unlock new revenue from sustainable commerce while cutting product waste.
experiences.standforua: I built a multilingual humanitarian aid platform that connected Ukrainians in need with volunteers around the world. I developed a request-matching system supporting over five languages with geographic mapping, helping thousands of people find food, services, and housing through secure contact coordination.
